definition: Annual T4-based individual labour units allocated by wages across employers; provinces excluding territories.
trend_review: Do not merge the ILUs with CA_esac_legacy, CA_esac_revised, or CA_esac_2015_undated as one employment trend or index. Do not convert, relabel, or compare the ILU totals as FTEs or point-in-time headcount. Do not combine the values with CA_contract_share or CA_immigration_share to estimate national contractor or citizenship counts.
